title: NFT Friends
tagline: Find your NFT Friends, Find and follow users that shared your NFT collections on Farcaster
description: The primary objective of this project is to elevate the user experience within blockchain environments, specifically focusing on the process of discovering and engaging with new friends via NFT-based interactions. By integrating the FarCaster protocol into existing workflows, the aim is to establish a more secure and seamless environment for users to connect and build relationships within the blockchain ecosystem.
how_its_made:
The project was made using Next.js, typescript, and React, using API to getch user and NFT data like Airstack, Using the Farcaster protocol, and authentication in Warpcast using Neynar

FarCaster Protocol Integration instead of Discord gated-channels:
By utilizing FarCaster's capabilities, users can engage in interactions with enhanced privacy protections, mitigating concerns related to clicking external links, joining discord servers and following people they do not know about
